title: Englisch — Past Simple vs. Present Perfect
subject: Englisch
description: Wann verwendet man Past Simple, wann Present Perfect?

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: 'Yesterday I ___ to the cinema.'
questions.explanation: 'Yesterday' = abgeschlossener Zeitpunkt in der Vergangenheit → Past Simple: went.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: 'She ___ already finished her homework.'
questions.explanation: 'already' ist ein Signalwort für Present Perfect. 3. Person Singular → has finished.

questions.prompt: Setze 'eat' in der richtigen Form ein: 'We ___ pizza last Friday.' (Nur das Verb angeben.)
Which signal words typically indicate Present Perfect?
questions.explanation: already, just, since/for → Present Perfect. yesterday → Past Simple.

choices.text: I have seen him last week.
I had seen him last week.

questions.explanation: 'last week' = abgeschlossen → Past Simple: saw. Mit Present Perfect dürfte keine konkrete Zeitangabe stehen.
